# Load reference

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
reference_choices <- readRDS("./data/public_genomes/reference_genome_detection/best_MERLIN_NCBI_reference_genome_choices.RDS") %>% ungroup %>% select(Ref_name,Ref_file_name,Ref_file,Sample) %>% distinct
```

# Move files

```{r}
NFS_PREFIX  <- '/nfs/turbo/umms-esnitkin/Project_MERLIN/Analysis/Household_transmission/MERLIN-prolonged-colonization-ms'
LOCAL_ROOT  <- path.expand('~/Desktop/gl_nfs/Project_MERLIN/Analysis/Household_transmission/MERLIN-prolonged-colonization-ms')

src_base <- sub(NFS_PREFIX, LOCAL_ROOT, reference_choices$Ref_file, fixed = TRUE)

dst_dirs <- file.path(LOCAL_ROOT, "data/public_genomes/reference_genomes",
                      reference_choices$Ref_name)

dir.create(file.path(LOCAL_ROOT, "data/public_genomes/reference_genomes"),
           showWarnings = FALSE)
invisible(lapply(dst_dirs, dir.create, showWarnings = FALSE))

# Vectorized — no loop needed, works correctly in knitr
file.copy(src_base,
          file.path(dst_dirs, paste0(reference_choices$Ref_name, ".fasta")),
          overwrite = FALSE)

file.copy(gsub("\\.fna$",".gbf",src_base),
          file.path(dst_dirs, paste0(reference_choices$Ref_name, ".gbf")),
          overwrite = FALSE)

file.copy(sub("\\.fna$", ".gff", src_base),
          file.path(dst_dirs, paste0(reference_choices$Ref_name, ".gff")),
          overwrite = FALSE)
```
